import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
palette = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

# Plot 2: Stress Level vs Physical Activity by Occupation (top 6 occupations)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Stress Level', 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Stress Level Distribution by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 3: Sleep Disorder Distribution with Sleep Duration
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Fill NaN in Sleep Disorder with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
sleep_disorder_avg = df.groupby('Sleep Disorder').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = range(len(sleep_disorder_avg))
width = 0.25
bars1 = ax3.bar([i - width for i in x], sleep_disorder_avg['Sleep Duration'], 
                width, label='Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='steelblue')
bars2 = ax3.bar(x, sleep_disorder_avg['Quality of Sleep'], 
                width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='forestgreen')
bars3 = ax3.bar([i + width for i in x], sleep_disorder_avg['Stress Level'], 
                width, label='Stress Level', color='coral')

ax3.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Value', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Metrics by Sleep Disorder Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_avg['Sleep Disorder'])
ax3.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 10)

# Plot 4: Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Variables
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='RdYlBu_r', center=0, 
            fmt='.2f', square=True, ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'size': 9})
ax4.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
